title: Journal/LDAP configuration repository and application gateway
summary: File backend is first write-before-memory durable journal; LDAP Identity dev18 can supply identity entities, delegated ACL metadata and synchronisation, but its replication and bind do not replace provisioning quorum or effectful route activation.
invariants: Stable directory entity id, not LDAP DN, denotes MI identity
LDAP Bind attributes identity; operation authority separately decides Search/Add/Modify/Delete
Use directory peer epoch/fencing and persisted outbox/ACK only for semantics they truly provide
Durable backend write/commit before memory promotion; last-good and last-staged separately persisted
Signed allocation is source of an immutable generation; services.tsv and routes.tsv are derived projections only
XTP gateway owns privileged transaction CONFIG_PREPARE/ACTIVATE/REVERT and SERVICE_LIVE checks; not implemented currently
No raw private keys in directory or Git; use Secret Broker/PKI provider references
procedure: Persist signed announcement and controller-approved head in append-only journal
Reconcile peer/outbox ACK using exact sequence and epoch
Prepare both service and route projections from one signed snapshot
Atomically cut over gateway generation after qualified health and policy checks
Durably record applied generation and isolate rollback path from compromised downloaded routes

qualification_boundaries.file_backend: proposed for provisioning; no production implementation
